audit.whatIsWrong: Full and content charts agree with each other (Ziggs / Skill / Aurora / Aurora / Ziggs / Aurora / Aurora) but disagree with both the packet chart and the chart the mirror audit says it set.
audit.why: The packet gives Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Ziggs / Aurora / Aurora; the mirror's note claims it set Ziggs / Skill / Aurora / Ziggs / Aurora / Ziggs / Ziggs and calls that 'identical to the packet chart', which it is not. Three sources, three answers — flipping rows here would guarantee a mirror disagreement, so no chart edits were proposed.
audit.corrected: No side or rating edits; raised as a question instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike attributes her burst to a 'Q-W combo plus E reset' with no cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: Twofold Hex (Q) is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Across the Veil (W) is 22/21/20/19/18s, The Weirding (E) is 15/14/13/12/11s and Between Worlds (R) is 140/120/100s. Her spike is the Q recast plus the W leap, and nothing in her kit resets E.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and spikes[1].text rebuilt on the real abilities; dosFull[0].d now states the 22s W.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page invents 'Across the Sanctuary', swaps her W and E throughout ('E dash-in', 'W spirit form'), and opens on the false claim that your Q out-ranges her.
audit.why: Across the Veil (W) is the 700-range leap that turns her invisible with bonus move speed — that is the gap-closer. The Weirding (E) is an 825-range blast that damages and slows and then hops her BACKWARD, so it is her exit, not her entry. Twofold Hex (Q) is 900 range against Bouncing Bomb's 850, so she out-ranges you; what you actually win is tempo, 6s to her 9s at rank 1. Spirit Abjuration (P) heals her off the spirits your chip damage generates, so Grievous Wounds decides long trades.
audit.corrected: tldr rebuilt on tempo; spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, wants.you[1], wants.you[2], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1] corrected to the real W/E roles; dontsFull[0].d now carries the anti-heal requirement.

notes: packet suspectName "Your Mega Inferno Bomb" is a FALSE POSITIVE. The label "Across the Veil (Hop)" is used as the focus name across roughly fifteen full-layer fields (winCon, enemyWin, tradeBad, loading, focus.text, phases[3].why, breakdown.early/wave/cooldowns/trading/feeding, dosFull[1].t, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[1]/[3]/[4]/[5]/[9]) — the name is real but the parenthetical is clutter and, worse, it is framed as her punish tool when Across the Veil is a leap into invisibility rather than a damage threat. A global label pass would fix all of them at once; I edited only the fields where I could also add real content. Aurora is female throughout the kit but the page says 'his/he' in tldr, winCon, tradeGood and several report entries.
